question: Should CUA support be deferred until upstream provides trustworthy create ownership, or narrowed now to a non-mutating doctor-only experimental provider?
rationale: The current upstream contract cannot safely attribute or clean up every remotely created billed sandbox after an ambiguous timeout, and code changes within Crabbox cannot manufacture that missing ownership primitive.

options.title: Defer mutating support
options.body: Pause this PR and keep https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/381 open until upstream provides and live-proves a causal create identity.

options.title: Narrow to doctor-only
options.body: Remove create, run, reuse, stop, cleanup, and archive mutation paths and retain only non-mutating SDK, auth, and environment diagnostics.

options.title: Accept orphan-resource risk
options.body: Ship the mutating provider while explicitly accepting that some create timeouts may leave billed resources Crabbox cannot identify or safely delete.

recommendation.title: Defer mutating support
recommendation.body: Pause this PR and keep https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/381 open until upstream provides and live-proves a causal create identity.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest ownership and cleanup hardening commits and have the strongest current-main security history around provider credentials.
